overall_validity.rationale: All configured variables and rules are implemented closely to their definitions: the coach remains strictly within an adherence-plus-education scope, uses only limited proactive outreach at routine check-in times, and operates under a daily cap with simple logging counters and basic demographic profile only. The patient–caregiver dyad matches the specified network, with low but non-zero engagement and neutral social orientation expressed via brief, task-focused replies that occur sporadically, mainly from the caregiver. Context updates are rare and minor (a single routine visit), condition remains stable, and no crises or new external factors are introduced. Consequences focus on clarity, adherence support, and valuing engaged, responsive messaging without penalizing reasonable length, consistent with an engagement-rewarded cost structure. Rendering obeys all instructions: each round includes consequence, context, resources, actors, and antecedent; there is no meta-talk or extraneous confound; time and counters evolve consistently across routine mornings. Any deviations, if present, are extremely minor and do not meaningfully affect interpretation, so the simulation is highly valid for studying behavior under this configuration.
